title: Witch Demands Manager
description: A skeletal witch in a pointed hat and flowing dark robes stands at a reception desk, pointing accusingly with a bony finger while speaking in floating text 'I WANT TO KNOW YOUR MANAGER'. A nervous female receptionist sits behind the counter holding a keyboard, with a service bell and scroll on the desk. A broken window in the background shows a glowing red moon with mathematical symbols and floating papers in a dark, chaotic atmosphere.
prompt: A skeletal witch with long dark hair and a pointed hat stands at a hotel reception desk, angrily pointing her finger at a nervous female receptionist while speech text reads 'I WANT TO KNOW YOUR MANAGER'. The witch has mathematical symbols and chains floating around her. Broken window behind shows a glowing red moon with equations. Papers and symbols float in the air, service bell and keyboard on the desk, dark fantasy style with purple and blue tones.
